text:
camille: Heads-up — aiming to cut the multi-repo release tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Need a quick sync on version bumps across api, runtime, console, sdks. Call out blockers now.
raj: Runtime has one perf PR (runtime#901) on thg-quant branch; smoke passes locally but perf test on large seqs still flaky. Need ~2h to finish a guard.
taylor: API PR api#1284 is ready; introduces header rename. I'll add a compat shim + changelog note.
luis: SDKs: node + python need bumps. Node CI is flaky on telemetry test, rerunning.
camille: Cutoff for code freeze = 09:30 UTC tomorrow. If you can't merge by then, leave a comment with @camille and add label "post-release".
ops-bot: deploy-check: base-images:green :white_check_mark:
raj: Quick detail — runtime will fall back to quant-cpu path for >8k tokens; adding runtime flag to control. Pushing small change now.
taylor: Linking PRs so ops knows what to watch: api#1284, runtime#901, sdk-node#342, sdk-py#218, console#77
luis: Node PR #342 green except flaky telemetry test. If it flakes again I'll revert telemetry in a patch.
camille: Changelog stub (please paste one-liners you want):
```
- API v1.2.0: header 'x-rdwd-org' renamed to 'x-rdwd-customer' (compat shim included)
- Runtime v0.9.7: KV-cache fallback path for long sequences; guard for memory spikes
- Console v0.5.3: realtime rollout logs + minor UI fixes
- SDKs v2.1.0: expose retry/backoff controls; updated error enums
```
raj: I've pushed image digest sha256:3f4b2c... to registry — recommend pinning in deployment manifests.
taylor: I'll update api deployment to use digest reference instead of tag.
luis: Publishing plan: bump to 2.1.0 for both node & py after release; will run npm publish checklist in release window.
camille: Release runbook (morning):
- 09:30 UTC: code freeze / final merges only with explicit ack
- 09:40 UTC: tag releases (runtime v0.9.7, api v1.2.0, console v0.5.3, sdks v2.1.0)
- 09:50 UTC: smoke deploy to staging
- 10:00–10:20 UTC: canary traffic (monitor latency & errors)
- 10:30 UTC: promote to prod if green
Please ack and paste PR numbers if you plan to merge after cutoff.
raj: ack — runtime#901 (may need hotfix if perf regressions show)
luis: ack — sdk-node#342, sdk-py#218 (will hold publishes until post-promote)
taylor: ack — api#1284, console#77
camille: Thanks. If CI weirdness blocks you, ping me and we'll carve out a hotfix window. :coffee:
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: release-cutoff in 30m
